title: The Dual DG Category to Weinstein's symplectic "category" and applications to Geometric Quantization
summary: In Weinstein's symplectic "category", objects are symplectic manifolds and morphisms are canonical relations, which may not be composable; it is therefore only morally a category. We construct a true differential graded category which is morally dual to Weinstein's "category". The objects in this category are prequantum systems, associated to integral symplectic manifolds. The morphisms are a complex of differential forms twisted by a prequantum line bundle. We also consider the cohomology category, which turns out to be an (ordinary) linear category.
